note: Both sets contain invented quotes, but Set A invents fewer: its "5/4 x 6 x 12 PRESSURE TREATED SURFACING", "1'-6"", "2\" x 4\" FRAMING" and "8\" FRAME" have no support in the text layer, while Set B adds fabricated items such as "3/8 x 4.5 HEX THROUGH-BOLT", "2 x 6 x 12 TREATED WOOD SURFACE", "3\" HEX THROUGH-BOLT", "1\" SLEEVE" and "2'-0\"". Set B also misbinds more real numbers to the wrong detail (1 1/2" and 7 1/2" are B1 deck-module-connection dimensions assigned to Detail C1, 1 1/4" is a landscape-footing dimension assigned to the deck module connection). Set A gets the core facts right (FIRST FLR 2'-4" above grade, 3/8 x 4 hex through bolt, 2x8 frame/joist, 3/4 x 5 1/2 plywood deck and reclaimed wood surface, C1 scale 6"=1'-0", 1" nut), though it too misbinds 3 3/4" to the deck module connection and the nails/screws to the footing. On balance Set A is somewhat more faithful with fewer unsupported claims.
